item.title: Study reveals how tuberculosis exploits immune defenses to promote infection
item.description: Scientists have made a discovery that helps explain why humans and animals are so susceptible to contracting tuberculosis(TB) – and it involves the bacteria harnessing part of the immune system meant to protect against infection.

item.title: Well-meaning ally interventions may increase emotional burden for marginalized workers
item.description: Someone in the office makes a racially insensitive comment, and a white co-worker asks a Black colleague to help correct the offender.

item.title: Online shopping and social media use linked to higher stress levels
item.description: Planning to save time by doing your shopping online? If so, it's possible you're not doing your well-being any favors.

item.title: Durvalumab extends survival in small cell lung cancer but raises cost concerns
item.description: A new study suggests that the immune checkpoint inhibitor, durvalumab, may offer new treatment options for patients living with small cell lung cancer (SCLC).

item.title: Ultrasound-responsive nanocatchers enable precise in-situ tumor antigen capture
item.description: Professor Zhaohui Tang and Associate Professor Zhilin Liu from the team of Professor Xuesi Chen at the Changchun Institute of Applied Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences, developed ultrasound-responsive in-situ antigen nanocatchers (S-nanocatchers), achieving precise spatiotemporal capture of tumor antigens and controllable acquisition of in-situ vaccines.

item.title: Earthworm-based composting offers a low-energy solution to antibiotic resistance
item.description: Earthworms could become unexpected allies in the global fight against antibiotic resistance, by helping farmers turn manure into safer, high-value organic fertilizer through a process called vermicomposting.

item.title: One Health action needed as environmental reservoirs fuel drug-resistant infections
item.description: Environmental antimicrobial resistance is turning rivers, soils, and even the air into hidden highways for "superbugs," according to a new review that calls for urgent, coordinated action across human, animal, and environmental health.

item.title: Study uncovers a neural brake that limits motivation during unpleasant situations
item.description: Most of us know the feeling: maybe it is making a difficult phone call, starting a report you fear will be criticized, or preparing a presentation that's stressful just to think about.

item.title: Aston Sci. Inc. implements CDD Vault to support AI-driven cancer vaccine development
item.description: Aston Sci. Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering next-generation therapeutic cancer vaccines, announced today that it has implemented CDD Vault®, the secure, cloud-based research informatics platform from Collaborative Drug Discovery (CDD).

item.title: AI automates sister chromatid exchange counting, improving diagnosis of Bloom syndrome
item.description: Researchers from Tokyo Metropolitan University have developed a suite of algorithms to automate the counting of sister chromatid exchanges (SCE) in chromosomes under the microscope.
